target.statement: HICL with HER_DPR achieves 41.53 EM on Natural Questions (NQ) with gpt-3.5-turbo, 5-shot

compute.basis: Requires re-implementing the full HICL pipeline (retriever, hint extraction, HER training) and calling gpt-3.5-turbo for hint extraction and final answers on 300 queries × 5 seeds, which is API-bound and cannot be GPU-accelerated.

blockers: No code or data release linked in the paper

title: Hint-enhanced In-Context Learning wakes Large Language Models up for knowledge-intensive tasks
